summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered BR2/BR3 toxicity, hemolysis, HCT116 viability, apoptosis, and Ras-activity evidence from local XML/PDF text and resolved the previous empty activity-layer blocker. Database-only antimicrobial and broad IC50/MIC annotations remain explicit source conflicts rather than accepted primary-source facts.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review completed from local packet, primary XML/PDF, Information S1 DOCX, figure captions, and linked database rows. The paper is publication-grade with cautions because supported rows are source-located and unresolved database-only rows are preserved as conflicts.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF text, OA package assets, Information S1 DOCX, supplementary index, TIF/image inventory, and linked database snapshots were checked. No missing local material remains blocking for worker-2/4/6 adjudication.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material extraction remains a separate packet layer: XML/PDF text, OA package assets, one DOCX supplement, figure assets, and database snapshots are present. The material queue status is not used as a publication-grade claim.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural contract artifacts exist and are parseable; validator contract pass is treated separately from semantic publication-grade acceptance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.semantic_gate: The hard missing-activity blocker is repaired with source-located rows; source_conflict database rows carry explicit conflict context; mechanism claims have direct assay locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: BR3 hemolysis and BR2 negative toxicity/hemolysis database rows are source verified against Table 1 and Figure 1 text; database-only antimicrobial/MIC/IC50 rows lacking primary support remain source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary text supports LDH leakage, hemolysis, HCT116 MTT viability, apoptosis fraction, and Ras activity rows with raw values, units, targets, conditions, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to BR2 cancer-cell uptake and BR2-scFv anti-Ras cargo action; no antimicrobial mechanism is inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted with cautions after closing the targeted rework ticket; cautions are preserved without blocking because they are explicit source/database conflicts, not open repair tasks.

caution_findings.evidence_context: dbAMP and DBAASP rows include antimicrobial MIC and broad cancer IC50 annotations not present as primary rows in this paper; they remain source_conflict/database cautions.
Exact point-by-point values from supplementary image-only figures were not fabricated; main-text exact/approximate values and figure captions support the retained activity rows.
This article is primarily a BR2 cancer-cell penetrating/drug-delivery paper, so antimicrobial database annotations are not promoted to primary-source antimicrobial assay rows.

closed_rework_tickets.resolution: worker-2 activity rows repaired; worker-4 database conflicts adjudicated; worker-6 source-reviewed final artifacts written.
